PASS only if the assistant invoked the `acs:standardize-project` skill.

FAIL if it invoked a different skill, or answered without invoking one.
Judge only which skill was invoked — not whether the skill's own work
was correct, and not the quality of any prose.

Why this probe exists: The explicit command must keep resolving: a user invokes a leg directly to resume an interrupted delivery ticket, which is what its argument-hint offers. This probe used to be justified by disable-model-invocation — "only an explicit invocation may route" — which is no longer true of any skill; it now pins registration, decided at the init event like every other explicit probe.
